arguments.sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('project',(SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM public.autsys_project_registry p WHERE lower(p.display_name)=lower('AUTSYS PC BRIDGE') OR p.project_key='AUTSYS_PC_BRIDGE' ORDER BY p.is_authoritative DESC,p.id LIMIT 1),'pluginCapabilities',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pc)-'id' ORDER BY pc.plugin_key,pc.capability_key) FROM public.plugin_capabilities_server pc WHERE pc.is_enabled=true),'[]'::jsonb),'externalCapabilities',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ec)-'id' ORDER BY ec.provider_key,ec.capability_key) FROM public.autsys_external_capabilities_registry ec WHERE ec.is_enabled=true),'[]'::jsonb)) AS bootstrap;
